decisions.reason: Because it extends the firm’s established automation offer and there is no sign of shortfall in a growing, investment-friendly firm with organisational slack, management would likely keep it on the market.

As another close-to-core loading solution, it fits the firm’s broad machinery portfolio and would usually be retained unless early results clearly missed aspirations, which the available evidence does not show.

Although it is more distant from the firm’s established offer and therefore riskier, its flagship status and Red Dot award suggest strategic commitment and acceptable early signals, making retention more likely than withdrawal.
